text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
When a Digimon with [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards would digivolve into this card, reduce the digivolution cost by 2.
[When Digivolving] Return all of your opponent's Digimon with the highest level to the bottom of their owners' decks in any order.
[When Digivolving][When Attacking][Once Per Turn] By placing 1 [X Antibody] or level 6 card from this Digimon's digivolution cards at the bottom of its owner's deck, reveal all of your opponent's security cards, and trash 1 of them. Place the rest in your opponent's security stack face down. Then, your opponent shuffles their security stack.

qa.answer: The player that activated this effect chooses.
qa.question: Which player chooses which of my opponent's security cards is trashed by this card's [When Digivolving][When Attacking] effect?

qa.answer:
Yes, you can activate it.
When a revealed card is trashed from the deck or security stack, it is not considered to be trashed from the deck or security stack, but it is considered that a card was removed from the security stack, so [BT4-097 Kari Kamiya]'s effect can be activated.

qa.question:
My security cards were revealed due to the [When Digivolving] effect of this opponent's card, and 1 of them was trashed.
Can I treat this as "when a card is removed from your security stack" and activate [BT4-097 Kari Kamiya]'s effect?
